output.question: Has USAA announced layoffs?
output.answer: Yes—USAA has publicly confirmed layoffs. An accessible summary of January 29, 2026 reporting says a USAA spokesperson confirmed job cuts, while sources estimated at least 400 affected employees across departments; that figure was not presented as company-confirmed. USAA also explicitly announced approximately 220 role eliminations in April 2024, citing changing business needs. I could not verify the details of a newer October 2026 report because the publisher’s page was inaccessible.

key_facts.fact: According to a summary of January 29, 2026 reporting, a USAA spokesperson confirmed job cuts; sources estimated 400 or more affected employees across departments.
As reported April 12, 2024, USAA announced approximately 220 role eliminations to reprioritize positions amid changing business needs.

passages.quote: A spokesperson confirmed jobs were cut
sources put the cuts at 400 or more across departments.
After careful consideration, we made the difficult decision to eliminate approximately 220 roles.

caveats: The January 2026 information comes from an accessible secondary summary, not an opened USAA release or the original report.
The January 2026 headcount estimate was attributed to sources, not confirmed by USAA.
Search surfaced a newer P&C Specialist report dated October 22, 2026, but its page could not be opened; its layoff details are therefore not returned as verified values.
The accessible sources establish that USAA has announced layoffs, but do not establish the latest company-confirmed layoff count as of November 11, 2026.
